$comment: The single place where the runtime name is written. Every other name of the vu monorepo (binary, packages, variables, branches, receipts) is a template over `name`; renaming the runtime means changing this value and regenerating the derived names (PLAN section 4.5). Owner decision of 2026-10-05: `vu`, the literal inverse of `uv`. The request first wrote « ir »; that wording is abandoned.
name: vu
